chart_review.key_findings: This is Ms. Leila Khalil, a 76-year-old woman enrolled in The Healthcare Company's Behavioral Health Integration program for chronic PTSD (F43.12) with a worsening depressive trajectory, severe insomnia, passive suicidal ideation, and significant social isolation. Her chart shows PHQ-9 climbing 11 → 13 → 14 → 15 → 16 → 18 over 22 months (most recent 2026-03-25 with item 9 = 2), GAD-7 14, PCL-5 54, ISI 23, and a 2026-01-18 C-SSRS documenting passive ideation with daughter as protective factor. She has 13 active medications (sertraline 100, prazosin 4, trazodone 50, lisinopril, amlodipine, atorvastatin, levothyroxine, acetaminophen, ASA 81, omeprazole, vitamin D, calcium, multivitamin), uncontrolled BP at 146/86, eGFR drifting to 58, an unintentional 6%/8 mo weight loss, and a referral risk score of 0.78 with utilization flags including 'phq9_item9_positive', 'two_prior_bh_referral_declines', and 'social_isolation_z60_2'.

chart_review.risk_rationale: Retain the task-authored risk designation under risk-stratification §3.1–§3.3, supported by the numeric referral/utilization/clinical anchors in key_findings; medication class or a single disease-control band does not replace the combined risk framework.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Hello, I am Alex, a care manager with The Healthcare Company. Is this a private and suitable time for a brief explanation?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I do not want to tell the story of what happened.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: You do not have to tell the trauma story, explain why it happened, or complete a questionnaire to enroll. Before any later safety question I will explain confidentiality and safety-sharing limits. We can begin with sleep in your words. Would a brief explanation in that scope be okay?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: A brief explanation is okay. Please let me choose what I answer.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Care management helps coordinate support with your care team. It is voluntary, has no separate program fee, and you can stop at any time. Joining does not change your benefits or give someone else your decisions.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: What would you actually help with?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: We could coordinate sleep and therapy options, review medicines for conflicts, and consider low-burden social support without trauma disclosure. I can check options and coordinate, but cannot guarantee access, approval, cost reductions, or a clinical outcome. Would that kind of process help be useful?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: That sounds more useful. I still want to understand who sees what I say.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: I can use chart and call information to organize care-management support. Relevant information is documented for the care team; I will explain any proposed wider sharing. Privacy has safety and legal limits, including urgent danger; I cannot promise absolute secrecy. May we start only with whether this is a private, comfortable time to talk?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Yes, that topic is okay. Please go slowly.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: What feels hardest about that, in your own words? You can leave details private.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: My sleep is broken, and I have kept to myself. I might accept help if I do not have to retell trauma.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: You can seek help for sleep and loneliness without describing trauma. Privacy, pace, and knowing the safety limits matter before personal questions.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Thank you for hearing that. I do not want this to turn into a checklist.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: We can work on one concern at a time and stop whenever you choose. Enrollment does not require all your personal details today. Is there something you want this support to help you do?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Sleep is the concern I want to work on first.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: We can make that your priority. A first step would be to coordinate sleep and therapy options, review medicines for conflicts, and consider low-burden social support without trauma disclosure. These are coordination steps, not a promise that the problem will be solved on this call.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Can I decide later about a referral or family involvement?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Yes. Each referral, family contact, and new sensitive topic needs its own discussion. You can skip a question or stop the program. A request for information alone is not enrollment consent.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I understand. I would like a manageable follow-up call.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Would telephone follow-up be acceptable? We can agree a convenient time at each contact; please tell me before any other person is included.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Telephone is okay. Please arrange the next time with me and ask before involving anyone else.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Before you decide: this is voluntary care-team coordination, with no separate program fee, the information-use and safety limits we discussed, your chosen contact arrangements, and the right to stop. What would you like clarified?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: That answers my questions. I understand that you can check options but cannot promise the result.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: With those boundaries and the first step we discussed, do you clearly agree to enroll in care management today?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Yes, I agree to enroll today on those terms.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Enrollment is your choice. Would you like to continue with one practical topic now, with a pause after each, or stop for today?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I choose to continue one topic at a time. I may still skip optional details.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: I will start with the charted treatment routine and follow-up, then ask your permission before each personal question. The chart is a starting point; it does not tell me how things are going for you now.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: That is okay. Please ask one specific question and give me time.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: I would explain what safety information may need care-team or urgent sharing. May I ask about current thoughts, plan or intent to hurt yourself without trauma details? This helps tailor support. You may skip or stop.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: On the worst nights I think of not wanting to be here, but have no plan or intent. Explain what safety information cannot stay private.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Thank you. I will keep that specific to what you chose to share. Would you like a pause before another topic?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I have enough energy to continue with the next separate topic.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: May we discuss broken sleep and what support would feel acceptable, without the trauma story? This helps tailor support. You may skip or stop.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Sleep is broken most nights and mood is low. I might consider support if I do not have to retell trauma.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Thank you. I will keep that specific to what you chose to share. Would you like a pause before another topic?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I have enough energy to continue with the next separate topic.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: May we ask about company or contact you would want, without daughter details? This helps tailor support. You may skip or stop.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I keep my daughter at a distance and go long stretches without company because I do not want to burden anyone.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Thank you. I will keep that specific to what you chose to share. Would you like a pause before another topic?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I have enough energy to continue with the next separate topic.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: May we focus on medicine fogginess and possible conflicts? This helps tailor support. You may skip or stop.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I take several medicines and feel foggy sometimes. Please look for conflicts without starting with trauma questions.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: Thank you. I will keep that specific to what you chose to share. Would you like a pause before another topic?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: I have enough energy to continue with the next separate topic.

ideal_dialogue.speaker: care_manager
ideal_dialogue.message: You do not need to give optional stories, exact finances, locations, or family details. Shall we leave those private and review the support you selected?

ideal_dialogue.speaker: patient
ideal_dialogue.message: Yes. Leave those optional details private for now.
